title: GA PSC Order — Docket 44151 (Letter Order)
text:
LETTER ORDER

DOCKET NO. 44151

July 7, 2026

Israel Max
Maxsip Tel LLC
181 South Franklin Avenue Suite 304
Valley Stream, NY 11581

IN RE: Cancellation of Certificate of Authority to Resell Interexchange 
Telecommunications Services (Resell).

Dear Israel Max:

At its July 7, 2026 Administrative Session, the Georgia Public Service Commission (the “Commission”) granted the Company's request to cancel certificate of authority number R-7866 and to withdraw the tariff of Maxsip Tel LLC to resell interexchange telecommunication services in Georgia.

The above by action of the Commission in Administrative Session on July 7, 2026.

_______________________________ ________________________________
Sallie Tanner Jason Shaw
Executive Secretary Chairman

DATE: _________________________ DATE: __________________________

C: Lance J.M. Steinhart, Esq.
